* '''PC-E1''' ([[Rebel Trooper Reinforcements (Errata)]], 29 March 2023): Players Committee card image, 29 March 2023: [[:File:V11-L-rebeltrooperreinforcements-20230329.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/168657a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/hires/rebeltrooperreinforcements.png Holotable commit 168657a “Set 11 Remastered”]), no mark.
